findings.issue: The proposed text changes the definite condition explaining why the response is incomplete into a possibility. 'May never be shown' weakens the original causal link and can even sound as though omitting the justification is permissible, despite justification being required for full credit.
findings.evidence: CURRENT: '...can still be an incomplete response if the justification step...is never shown.' PROPOSED: 'A correct critical point and a correct final number can still be an incomplete response.' followed by 'The justification step...may never be shown.'
